##### Project general facts

Jebel Sifah – Solaris is a contemporary residential development that brings together resort-style living and the natural beauty of Oman’s coastline. Offering a collection of studio, one-, and two-bedroom apartments, the project is designed to create a seamless balance between modern comfort and tranquil surroundings. Each residence features elegant interiors, open-plan layouts, and expansive views of the golf course and the sea, delivering a sophisticated lifestyle in one of Jebel Sifah’s most scenic settings.

Residents enjoy a carefully curated range of lifestyle amenities designed to support wellness, leisure, and everyday relaxation. The development features a fully equipped fitness gym, wellness spa, common swimming pool with a tanning deck, jogging track, and a dedicated BBQ area with outdoor seating and tented gathering spaces. Surrounded by beautifully landscaped areas and panoramic natural views, Solaris offers a vibrant community atmosphere where outdoor living and resort-style comfort come together effortlessly.

Each apartment is finished with high-quality contemporary materials that enhance both style and durability throughout the interiors. Kitchens are fitted with built-in appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their living spaces and create a home that reflects their own taste within this exceptional coastal community.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Sifah is a picturesque coastal destination located just 45 minutes from Muscat, Oman’s vibrant capital. Nestled between the rugged Al Hajar Mountains and the serene waters of the Arabian Sea, this idyllic locale offers breathtaking natural beauty and a tranquil environment. Its unspoiled beaches and stunning landscapes create an oasis of relaxation, perfect for those seeking a peaceful coastal retreat.

As a premium residential and lifestyle destination, Jebel Sifah boasts a harmonious blend of modern living and traditional charm. The area features elegant residential developments, a state-of-the-art marina, and an array of fine dining and leisure options. Its thoughtful design and luxurious amenities ensure a sophisticated lifestyle amidst nature's beauty, making it a sought-after location for homeowners and investors alike.

Jebel Sifah’s appeal extends beyond luxury living to an active lifestyle focused on wellness and recreation. With pristine beaches, golf courses, hiking trails, and water sports, the community caters to outdoor enthusiasts and families alike. Its seamless integration of nature, luxury, and recreation makes Jebel Sifah a unique gem on Oman’s picturesque coastline.
